Triage (routing only, held as `finding`): accepting the card's own routing argument — this is a published-API-surface decision on `@objectstack/spec` (un-exporting is `check:api-surface`-breaking, publishing the type widens the public face) ⇒ `domain:spec`, not spec-surface. Zero measured pull, existing state is inert-but-reachable; correctly held rather than queued. If graded worth doing, the un-export route rides a major with an ADR-0087 registry entry per the card.

Grading (held as `finding`, type Task) — 本评论来自分诊座位 Routine.

**Held, with a named re-grade trigger.** All three dispositions touch the published surface (un-exporting is technically breaking even if practically inert; publishing `StrictObjectOptions` widens the public face), so the call belongs to the maintainer — but with zero measured pull and no consumer able to use the export in a typed way today, it does not earn a decision-inbox slot now. Leave-and-note is the correct interim state, and this card is the note.

**Re-grade trigger:** when a v18 major-train ADR-0087 removal batch opens (the #5082 family is the anchor), surface this card into that batch — the un-export-vs-publish decision rides the major with the rest of the retirement registry, where it costs the maintainer one line instead of a standalone ruling.

Part A was approved 2026-08-07 (5219867430) and its quick wins were filed separately; Part B's hold (2026-08-09, 5230641358) waited for demonstrated pull — that pull, when it comes, arrives as its own card for that one type, which is the hold's own restart shape. Studio rows on the road today cover objects / fields / lists / forms / pages / docs, not these types. **This close supersedes the 2026-08-09 hold, on the maintainer's word.** |
| #8213 | Its `Restart-when:` already names the next v18 ADR-0087 removal batch (the #5082 family); 阶段姿态 「按发布批量退役,不一键一卡」 ⇒ the note rides #5082 as a pointer (posted this act), not an open card. Zero pull; an inert export. |
